record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.original_question: Let GH be the space of globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter structures on a closed surface bundle M = S × R. Using the maximal-surface parameterization GH ≅ T*Teich(S) and the left-right parameterization GH ≅ Teich(S) × Teich(S), one gets a map φ : T*Teich(S) → Teich(S) × Teich(S). Is φ symplectic, in the sense that the pullback of the difference of the Weil–Petersson symplectic forms equals, up to a constant, the canonical cotangent symplectic structure on T*Teich(S)?

evidence.quote: Question 8.1. Is φ symplectic, that is, is the pull-back by φ of the difference of the Weil–Petersson symplectic forms on the two factors in the image equal (up to a constant) to the cotangent symplectic structure on T∗T ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus at least $2$, and let $M = S \times \mathbb{R}$. Denote by $\mathcal{GH}$ the deformation space of globally hyperbolic maximal compact (GHMC) anti-de Sitter structures on $M$. Two well-known parameterizations of $\mathcal{GH}$ are available:

(1) The maximal surface parameterization: every GHMC anti-de Sitter structure on $M$ contains a unique embedded maximal Cauchy surface $\Sigma$ isotopic to $S \times \{0\}$, and assigning to a structure the pair (induced conformal class on $\Sigma$, second fundamental form viewed as a holomorphic quadratic differential) yields a diffeomorphism
$$\Psi : \mathcal{GH} \xrightarrow{\;\cong\;} T^{*}\mathcal{T}(S),$$
where $\mathcal{T}(S)$ is the Teichmüller space of $S$ and $T^{*}\mathcal{T}(S)$ carries its canonical cotangent symplectic structure $\omega_{\mathrm{can}}$.

(2) The left–right (Mess) parameterization: the holonomy representation into $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R}) \times \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$ produces a diffeomorphism
$$\Phi : \mathcal{GH} \xrightarrow{\;\cong\;} \mathcal{T}(S) \times \mathcal{T}(S),$$
and on the target one considers the symplectic form $\omega_{\mathrm{WP}} \boxminus \omega_{\mathrm{WP}} := \pi_{1}^{*}\omega_{\mathrm{WP}} - \pi_{2}^{*}\omega_{\mathrm{WP}}$, where $\omega_{\mathrm{WP}}$ is the Weil–Petersson symplectic form on $\mathcal{T}(S)$.

Define
$$\varphi := \Phi \circ \Psi^{-1} : T^{*}\mathcal{T}(S) \longrightarrow \mathcal{T}(S) \times \mathcal{T}(S).$$

Question. Is $\varphi$ symplectic, in the sense that there exists a nonzero constant $c \in \mathbb{R}$ with
$$\varphi^{*}\bigl(\pi_{1}^{*}\omega_{\mathrm{WP}} - \pi_{2}^{*}\omega_{\mathrm{WP}}\bigr) \;=\; c\,\omega_{\mathrm{can}}\;?$$
artifact.category_tag: Anti-de Sitter geometry and Teichmüller theory
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears to have been answered affirmatively. Mazzoli, Seppi, and Tamburelli (arXiv:2107.10363, "Para-hyperKähler geometry of the deformation space of maximal globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter three-manifolds", Memoirs AMS) study the symplectic structures on the GHMC deformation space and identify the canonical cotangent symplectic form on T*Teich(S) with the difference of Weil–Petersson forms via the Mess homeomorphism. Subsequent work (e.g., the 2024 paper on maximal discs of Weil–Petersson class) summarises this as: "the Mess map defines a symplectic diffeomorphism from T*𝒯 to 𝒯 × 𝒯 with respect to the canonical symplectic form and the difference of pullbacks of the Weil–Petersson symplectic forms." Earlier related work by Scarinci–Schlenker also addresses the symplectic equivalence.

status_evidence.title: Para-hyperKähler geometry of the deformation space of MGHC anti-de Sitter three-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: A neutral pseudo-Riemannian metric and three symplectic structures... related to the geometry of MGHC manifolds via the Mess homeomorphism, the parameterization of Krasnov–Schlenker by the induced metric on K-surfaces, the identification with the cotangent bundle T*𝒯(Σ).
status_evidence.claim: This work establishes the symplectic compatibility between the cotangent and Mess parameterizations of the GHMC deformation space.

status_evidence.title: Maximal discs of Weil–Petersson class in AdS^{2,1}
status_evidence.snippet: The Mess map defines a symplectic diffeomorphism from T*T_0(1) to T_0(1) × T_0(1) with respect to the canonical symplectic form and the difference of pullbacks of the Weil-Petersson symplectic forms.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous statement (in the universal Teichmüller setting, modeled on the closed-surface result) confirms that φ pulls back the difference of WP forms to the canonical cotangent symplectic form.
